title: A Julia-Fatou Theory via Random Systems with Complete Connections
summary: We develop a Julia-Fatou theory for random dynamical systems of continuous self-maps on compact metric spaces driven by random systems with complete connections (RSCCs). To each index, we assign either a family of continuous self-maps or a probability measure supported on such a family. Together with these assigned objects, a random index sequence gives rise to a random dynamical system on the compact metric space.
